scripts.build: vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist/server && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy: npm run build && node scripts/check-production.mjs && wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --env staging
scripts.db:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env staging
scripts.db:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env production
